# Changelog

All notable protocol changes are recorded here.

## [0.1.0] — 2026-07-21

Initial Working Draft.

### Added

- Design Source Document (`desen.source`).
- Published Design Bundle (`desen.bundle`).
- Capability Catalog (`desen.catalog`).
- Component, behavior, operation, and resource capability contracts.
- Props, named slots, events, commands, style parts, visual states, and authoring scenarios.
- Surface-local state, resource instances, references, predicates, variants, repeats, and actions.
- Publish-time source and bundle digest rules.
- Exact capability package id/version/target/digest pinning.
- Authoring and production runtime semantics.
- Atomic activation and last-known-good requirement.
- Data-only security model and reference resource limits.
- Sign-in, map, and sortable-list examples.
- JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 schemas.
- Starter conformance vectors and validator.

### Deliberately excluded

- telemetry, experimentation, governance, and rollout;
- voice, AR, and VR;
- arbitrary executable expressions;
- backend generation;
- mandatory source-code export;
- collaboration and marketplace functionality.
